summary: Built abstain-by-default context-need gate (lib/context-gate.js): INJECT iff top1 cosine>=0.55 AND margin(top1-top2)>=0.12 AND top note is EMPIRICAL scar-tissue (gotcha/decision/root-cause), else ABSTAIN. Offline labeled eval (bench/context-gate-eval.js → .md) over report-v2..v7: 11 problems, all needs_context=NO (every ON arm did more hardness than OFF), gate abstains everywhere → REGRET=0 tok-eq, ~690K tok-eq over-deliberation tax avoided. 15/15 unit tests pass incl. real-embedding positive case (sharp+specific+empirical note → INJECT, top1=0.83/margin=0.60) proving it's not always-abstain. Headline: gate identifies non-beneficial retrieval; on v1–v7 abstains with ~0 regret — we do not lose where memory doesn't help. Inject-threshold calibration deferred to task #5. Offline only, no new agent runs, daemon untouched.
